purpose: Freeze the Stage E evidence baseline that every Stage F comparison must use.

halo2_proofs.diff_vs_crates_io: only src/plonk/prover.rs (E2 timers + E3 stage tags)

pasta_curves.note: 0.6.1 exists and adds an `asm` backend; it is NOT in the frozen graph.

sampling_perturbation.note: +8.1% and +15.4% were early single-run readings and are RETRACTED. Only +5.6% / +10.3% may be cited.

metric_conventions.self_pct: leaf frame function; denominator = busy samples; additive to 100%
metric_conventions.coverage_pct: function present >=1 time in stack; NOT additive, may exceed 100%
metric_conventions.wall_share: E2 phase interval / create_proof outer wall clock; additive
metric_conventions.rule: 1P: stage_cpu_share ~= wall_share. 8P: wall_share_i ~= cpu_share_i / speedup_i (NOT equal).

fingerprint_conventions.hash_normalization: sha256 over LF-normalised bytes (CRLF->LF); .gitattributes pins these paths to `text eol=lf` so a clone reproduces them exactly
fingerprint_conventions.halo2_src_scope: concatenation of the 57 .rs files under vendor/halo2_proofs-0.4.0/src, sorted by path
fingerprint_conventions.pasta_src_scope: concatenation of the 16 .rs files under the cargo registry copy of pasta_curves-0.6.0/src, sorted by path
